title: Product detail: Ridgeline 40 L pack
content:
Product page for the Ridgeline 40 L backpack. Price: $189. Rating: 4.7 out of 5 from 212 reviews.

Description: A 40-liter pack for multi-day trips. The frame transfers weight to your hips, and the side zip lets you reach the bottom without unpacking.

Options: Color (Moss, Slate, Ember) and Size (S/M, M/L). Both are required. Quantity, 1 to 5.
Buttons: Add to cart (submits the order form), Save to wishlist.

Specifications:
- Capacity: 40 L
- Weight: 1.4 kg
- Fabric: 210-denier recycled nylon
- Torso range: 41–53 cm
- Warranty: lifetime, with free repairs at the co-op

Photos: four views (front, back panel, side zip open, on a hiker).
Reviews (two shown): "Carried it 90 km on the Coast Trail without a sore hip." — Dana, 5 stars. "Wish the hip belt pockets were larger." — Theo, 4 stars.
Breadcrumbs: Home › Shop › Backpacks › Ridgeline 40 L.
